## What — Experiment suite

- Phase 0–1 establish the reference: upstream runs (Exp 1), our loop is exact (Exp 2), the frontier reproduces (Exp 3).
- Obs 1 reads the frontier's bad cases and turns them into refresh levers.
- Phases 2–4 test whether refresh can be spent better than every k steps (Exp 4 onward).
- Run log, decisions and lever maps: [`docs/PROGRESS.md`](../PROGRESS.md). Plan: [`plans/research_plan_v2.md`](../../plans/research_plan_v2.md).

| ID | Question | Phase / gate | Status | Headline |
|:--:|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| [Exp 1](exp1_upstream_smoke.qmd) | Does upstream run; what does a sample cost? | 0 | ✅ | k = 1 = full on 5/5; N ~3k (3× plan) |
| [Exp 2](exp2_loop_identity.qmd) | Is our refresh loop exact? | 1 · G1(i) | ✅ PASS | 30/30 token-identical, ≤ 0.2% time gap |
| [Exp 3](exp3_mme_frontier.qmd) | Does the published frontier reproduce? | 1 · G1(ii) | ✅ PASS* | 6/6 speedups ±20%; 5/6 Jaccards ±0.05 |
| [Obs 1](obs1_frontier_bad_cases.qmd) | Are low-agreement captions worse, and where do they split? | 1 | ✅ | Different, not worse; split decided early |
| Exp 4 | Fixed-interval frontier on MathVerse (accuracy anchors) | 1 | 🔄 running | Interim n = 126: no accuracy loss up to k = 32 |
| [Exp 5](exp5_replacement_error_map.qmd) | Replacement-error map: when and where staleness flips tokens (D3, D1, bands) | 2 · G2 | ✅ PASS (captions) | Top 20% of cells hold 60.8%; text 21.7× per position, layers 16–31 78% |

\* accepted by the user with one recorded deviation (k = 2 Jaccard off by 0.001, inside our 95% CI).

## Why — Validation strategy

- **Reference before method**: a policy only counts against a fixed-interval curve that matches the paper.
- **Bad cases before policies** (user decision 2026-10-29): read failures to find levers, aim for a positive result.
- **Accuracy sets the anchors**: Obs 1 shows Jaccard vs full near k = 2 tracks trajectory, not quality.
- **Repetition**: deterministic decoding, one run per arm, paired `Δ [95% CI] (n)` over samples
  (`.claude/research.md`). This replaces the template's "mean ± std over seeds".
- **Timing**: one GPU type per table (A100 80GB PCIe so far), generation time only.

## How — Data, arms, metrics

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| Model | `GSAI-ML/LLaDA-V` (snapshot `a10ba17`), SigLIP-2 so400m tower, bf16, sdpa |
| Captioning | 50 unique MME images (seed 0), "Please describe the image in detail.", gen = steps = block = 128, threshold 0.5 |
| Arms so far | full recompute; fixed interval k ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32} |
| Quality | Jaccard over lowercased word sets vs full (captions); task accuracy (MathVerse, primary, pending) |
| Cost | wall-clock seconds per sample; speedup over full; r = refreshes / forwards |
